risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first in Item 1A with strong emphasis on governance by the Board and Audit Committee. The language stresses the criticality of a robust program amid growing threats. Regular oversight by the SIRT and CIO, along with frequent reporting to the Committee, indicates critical exposure. Highly weighted category due to the sensitivity of customer data.

risks.title: Dependence on Commercial Leases
risks.score_rationale: Described in Item 2, Properties, where 2,900 stores are leased. While most leases can be terminated in the event of adverse regulatory changes, geographic concentration and operational reliance on leased locations represent a moderate to high risk. Renewal or loss of strategic leases could impact profitability.

risks.title: Litigation and Regulatory Actions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 3, the company faces litigation in the ordinary course of business. Management believes resolution will not have a material effect, suggesting routine management. However, ongoing exposure to regulatory actions in the high-cost credit financial services sector remains a latent risk.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk and Geographic Exposure
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in the United States, Latin America, and the United Kingdom. This international presence entails foreign exchange, local inflation, and political stability risks, particularly in emerging markets such as Mexico, Jamaica, Colombia, and Guadeloupe. The Mexican peso represents a material exposure with an average rate of 19.2:1 in 2025. A one-point movement would impact annual results by $4.4 million.

risks.title: Recent Acquisition in the UK (H T)
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of H T in the UK in August 2025 is a major change (cited in Item 9A). Integration carries operational, cultural, and synergy risks. H T represents approximately 11% of total assets and 4% of consolidated revenue as of December 31, 2025. The risk is new and not yet stabilized, with potential impact on profitability if integration fails.
